summary: Implement strategies to minimize cold start times for Azure Functions to improve user experience.
description: This project focuses on implementing effective strategies to mitigate cold start times associated with Azure Functions, which can significantly impact user experience. Cold starts occur when an Azure Function is triggered after being idle, leading to delays in execution. The goal of this project is to analyze the current function architecture, identify bottlenecks, and apply best practices to enhance performance. Strategies may include optimizing function code, adjusting hosting plans, utilizing pre-warmed instances, and leveraging Azure's built-in features such as Durable Functions. The outcome will be a comprehensive report detailing the implemented strategies, along with performance metrics demonstrating the improvements achieved. This project is essential for businesses relying on Azure Functions to ensure a seamless and responsive user experience.
